description: The words both products print for a hosted run's error text (a run record's or completion's `error`, a stream error event, a draft writer error). The first entry whose `contains` is a substring of the service's text gives the message; any other text prints `fallback`, so no internal stage or component name is ever echoed. With the environment variable `debugEnv` set to 1 the service's text is printed as it was received (redacted, control characters removed), for debugging.

messages.message: The run hit its 16-step limit before finishing.
The run used up its budget.

fallback: The run failed on the service.
